text:
U.S. stocks were mixed pre-market (SPX unchanged, NDX -0.4%) as the global chip selloff persisted, with Samsung and SK Hynix plunging in Asia. Brent fell 1.5% to $105 as Saudi Arabia intercepted Houthi missiles and President Trump threatened to get involved on Saudi Arabia’s behalf.  The 10-year treasury yield eased 5.0bp to 5.19%. Banks kick off Q3 earnings today followed by tech heavyweights $ASML and $TSM later this week.  Sept CPI is due tomorrow, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh speaks on Friday at an IMF-World Bank event. 

S&P 2026 EPS estimates of $367 continue to rise (+32% YoY) and imply a 21.3x P/E and 4.7% yield, remaining  inverted versus Treasuries, a rare setup outside the late-1990s dot-com bubble. Treasury yields are expected to retreat as the Iran conflict ends. I remain cautious on TSLA given its extended valuation, negative forward earnings revisions, and autonomous driving commoditization by competitors.

name: Serenity
zh_summary: @aleabitoreddit 認為實體 AI 和人形機器人是 AI 的下一階段，$NVDA 在 CES 2025 的預測以及 Elon 對 $TSLA 十年內 10 億臺人形機器人的預言正在加速。宇樹執行長 8 月時認為機器人的「ChatGPT 時刻」最快需兩到三年，最長可達十年，測試 GPT-6 後現在預期 1 到 2 年內就會出現，定義為機器人能在 80% 的陌生環境中完成約 80% 的任務。他們引用一項機械手基準：碗任務中 Astra 20 次成功 19 次，Fable 5.1 為 8 次；拼圖任務兩者都只有 20 次中 2 次。
text:
Physical AI + Humanoids are the next progression of AI.

$NVDA CES 2025 projections and Elon's prediction on $TSLA + 1 Billion humanoids in the next decade, seems to be speeding up. 

New statement from Unitree CEO after testing GPT-6 on their humanoid program was that:

- In August, before GPT-6's release, Wang said the industry could take two to three years at its fastest pace, or as long as a decade, to reach its "ChatGPT moment"

- Now, OpenAI's GPT-6 model prompted expectations that a breakthrough could happen "within 1 or 2 years"

- He defined that moment as robots being able to complete around 80 per cent of tasks in 80 per cent of unfamiliar environments using voice or text commands.

- "It's possible that, say, a GPT-7 model released next year could directly crack the problems of embodied intelligence"

- "The whole embodied intelligence industry has been shaken up after the release of GPT-6"

Just looking at some benchmarks on robotic hand manipulation, "On the bowl task Astra placed the block in 19 of 20 trials, against Fable 5.1's 8 of 20".

But for the puzzle task "Astra completed the insertion 2 times in 20 against Fable 5.1's 2 in 20"".. so we're getting there. 

But going from 2-3 years (potentially to a decade), and compressing that down to 1 or 2 years (to achieve 80%+ of tasks in unfamiliar environemnts) is a significant change in outlook.
